headline: [Weekly Finance Issues] First Week of Expanded Household Loan Ceiling; Shortage of Balance Payment Loans Not Yet Resolved
summary: The expanded household loan ceiling has taken effect, and supply of balance payment loans is expected to ease. Follow-up procedures remain before actual supply expands.
why: Household loan limits set by regulators determine how much banks can lend to consumers, affecting bank loan growth and household credit.
